# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Lint
      # The safe navigation operator returns nil if the receiver is
      # nil. If you chain an ordinary method call after a safe
      # navigation operator, it raises NoMethodError. We should use a
      # safe navigation operator after a safe navigation operator.
      # This cop checks for the problem outlined above.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   x&.foo.bar
      #   x&.foo + bar
      #   x&.foo[bar]
      #
      #   # good
      #   x&.foo&.bar
      #   x&.foo || bar
      class SafeNavigationChain < Base
        include NilMethods
        extend AutoCorrector
        extend TargetRubyVersion

        minimum_target_ruby_version 2.3

        MSG = 'Do not chain ordinary method call after safe navigation operator.'
        PLUS_MINUS_METHODS = %i[+@ -@].freeze
        SNAKE_CASE = /\A[[:digit:][:upper:]_]+\z/.freeze
        ARITHMETIC_OPERATORS = %i[+ - * / % ** +@ -@].freeze
        COMPARISON_OPERATORS = %i[== === != <= >= < > <=>].freeze
        BITWISE_OPERATORS = %i[& | ^ << >>].freeze
        CONVERSION_METHODS = %i[to_h to_a to_i to_f to_s to_d to_r to_c to_sym to_str to_int to_ary to_hash].freeze
        NIL_QUERY_METHODS = %i[nil? blank? present? empty? any? none? one? many?].freeze
        RECEIVER_EXISTENCE_METHODS = %i[instance_of? kind_of? is_a? eql? respond_to? equal?].freeze

        # @!method bad_method?(node)
        def_node_matcher :bad_method?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (send $(csend ...) $_ ...)
            (send $({block numblock} (csend ...) ...) $_ ...)
          }
        PATTERN

        def on_send(node)
          inspect_send_for_chain_policies(node)
          inspect_send_for_paren_policies(node)
          return unless require_safe_navigation?(node)

          bad_method?(node) do |safe_nav, method|
            return if nil_methods.include?(method) || PLUS_MINUS_METHODS.include?(node.method_name)

            begin_range = node.loc.dot || safe_nav.source_range.end
            location = begin_range.join(node.source_range.end)

            add_offense(location) do |corrector|
              autocorrect(corrector, offense_range: location, send_node: node)
            end
          end
        end

        def self.shared_inspector
          @shared_inspector ||= allocate
        end

        def self.handle_redundant_csend(cop, node)
          shared_inspector.evaluate_redundant_csend(cop, node)
        end

        def self.handle_redundant_or(cop, node)
          shared_inspector.evaluate_redundant_or(cop, node)
        end

        def self.handle_consistency(cop, node)
          shared_inspector.evaluate_consistency(cop, node)
        end

        def self.handle_style_if(cop, node)
          shared_inspector.evaluate_style_if(cop, node)
        end

        def self.handle_style_and(cop, node)
          shared_inspector.evaluate_style_and(cop, node)
        end

        def self.handle_chain_length(cop, node)
          shared_inspector.evaluate_chain_length(cop, node)
        end

        def self.handle_empty_in_conditional(cop, node)
          shared_inspector.evaluate_empty_in_conditional(cop, node)
        end

        def inspect_send_for_chain_policies(node)
          @chain_snapshot = node
          @chain_nodes = []
          @chain_tail = node
          record_chain_send_type(node)
          record_chain_csend_type(node)
          record_chain_block_type(node)
          record_chain_numblock_type(node)
          record_chain_dot_style(node)
          record_chain_safe_style(node)
          record_chain_operator_style(node)
          record_chain_assignment_style(node)
          record_chain_comparison_style(node)
          record_chain_predicate_style(node)
          record_chain_negation_style(node)
          record_chain_bang_bang(node)
          record_chain_bracket_read(node)
          record_chain_bracket_write(node)
          record_chain_arithmetic_plus(node)
          record_chain_arithmetic_minus(node)
          record_chain_const_receiver(node)
          record_chain_self_receiver(node)
          record_chain_nil_receiver(node)
          record_chain_literal_receiver(node)
          record_chain_parent_pair(node)
          record_chain_parent_hash(node)
          record_chain_parent_send(node)
        end

        def inspect_send_for_paren_policies(node)
          @paren_context = node
          @paren_parent_type = node_parent_type(node)
          @paren_operator = node_operator_key(node)
          record_paren_pair_parent(node)
          record_paren_hash_parent(node)
          record_paren_array_parent(node)
          record_paren_begin_parent(node)
          record_paren_and_parent(node)
          record_paren_or_parent(node)
          record_paren_if_parent(node)
          record_paren_while_parent(node)
          record_paren_until_parent(node)
          record_paren_case_parent(node)
          record_paren_masgn_parent(node)
          record_paren_op_asgn_parent(node)
          record_paren_or_asgn_parent(node)
          record_paren_and_asgn_parent(node)
          record_paren_defined_parent(node)
          record_paren_splat_parent(node)
          record_paren_kwsplat_parent(node)
          record_paren_yield_parent(node)
          record_paren_super_parent(node)
          record_paren_return_parent(node)
          record_paren_block_pass_parent(node)
          record_paren_dstr_parent(node)
          record_paren_xstr_parent(node)
        end

        def evaluate_consistency(cop, node)
          @consistency_operands = []
          @consistency_groups = {}
          @consistency_dot_op = nil
          all_operands = consistency_collect_operands(node, [])
          @consistency_operands = all_operands
          operand_groups = all_operands.group_by { |operand| consistency_receiver_name_as_key(operand, +'') }
          @consistency_groups = operand_groups
          record_consistency_and_operand(node)
          record_consistency_or_operand(node)
          record_consistency_csend_operand(node)
          record_consistency_send_operand(node)
          record_consistency_dot_operand(node)
          record_consistency_safe_operand(node)
          record_consistency_operator_operand(node)
          record_consistency_begin_operand(node)
          record_consistency_const_operand(node)
          record_consistency_self_operand(node)
          record_consistency_literal_operand(node)
          record_consistency_nil_operand(node)
          record_consistency_comparison_operand(node)
          record_consistency_assignment_operand(node)
          record_consistency_predicate_operand(node)
          record_consistency_bracket_operand(node)
          record_consistency_plus_operand(node)
          record_consistency_minus_operand(node)
          record_consistency_pair_operand(node)
          record_consistency_hash_operand(node)
          record_consistency_if_operand(node)
          record_consistency_array_operand(node)
          record_consistency_return_operand(node)
          operand_groups.each_value do |grouped_operands|
            next unless (dot_op, begin_of_rest_operands = consistency_find_consistent_parts(cop, grouped_operands))

            @consistency_dot_op = dot_op
            rest_operands = grouped_operands[begin_of_rest_operands..]
            rest_operands.each do |operand|
              next if consistency_already_appropriate_call?(operand, dot_op)

              consistency_register_offense(cop, operand, dot_op)
            end
          end
        end

        def evaluate_redundant_csend(cop, node)
          @redundancy_node = node
          @redundancy_receiver = node.receiver
          @redundancy_kind = nil
          record_redundant_const_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_self_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_nil_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_literal_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_int_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_float_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_str_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_sym_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_array_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_hash_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_regexp_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_range_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_true_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_false_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_lvar_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_ivar_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_cvar_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_gvar_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_send_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_csend_receiver(node)
          record_redundant_condition_parent(node)
          record_redundant_and_parent(node)
          record_redundant_or_parent(node)
          unless assume_receiver_instance_exists?(node.receiver)
            return unless redundant_check?(node) && cop.send(:allowed_method?, node.method_name)
            return if cop.send(:respond_to_nil_specific_method?, node)
          end

          range = node.loc.dot
          cop.add_offense(range) { |corrector| corrector.replace(range, '.') }
        end

        def evaluate_redundant_or(cop, node)
          @redundancy_node = node
          @redundancy_receiver = node
          @redundancy_kind = :or
          cop.send(:conversion_with_default?, node) do |send_node|
            @redundancy_receiver = send_node.receiver
            range = send_node.loc.dot.begin.join(node.source_range.end)

            cop.add_offense(range, message: cop.class::MSG_LITERAL) do |corrector|
              corrector.replace(send_node.loc.dot, '.')

              range_with_default = node.lhs.source_range.end.begin.join(node.source_range.end)
              corrector.remove(range_with_default)
            end
          end
        end

        def evaluate_style_if(cop, node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = nil
          @style_method_chain = nil
          record_style_if_node(node)
          record_style_ternary_node(node)
          record_style_unless_node(node)
          record_style_and_node(node)
          record_style_or_node(node)
          record_style_send_node(node)
          record_style_csend_node(node)
          record_style_nil_check(node)
          record_style_not_node(node)
          record_style_empty_method(node)
          record_style_dot_method(node)
          record_style_safe_method(node)
          record_style_operator_method(node)
          record_style_assignment_method(node)
          record_style_comparison_method(node)
          record_style_block_method(node)
          record_style_const_receiver(node)
          record_style_self_receiver(node)
          record_style_literal_receiver(node)
          record_style_pair_parent(node)
          record_style_hash_parent(node)
          record_style_begin_parent(node)
          record_style_return_parent(node)
          return if style_allowed_if_condition?(node)

          checked_variable, receiver, method_chain, _method = style_extract_parts_from_if(cop, node)
          @style_variable = checked_variable
          @style_receiver = receiver
          @style_method_chain = method_chain
          return unless style_offending_node?(cop, node, checked_variable, method_chain, receiver)

          body = style_extract_if_body(node)
          method_call = receiver.parent

          removal_ranges = [style_begin_range(cop, node, body), style_end_range(cop, node, body)]

          style_report_offense(cop, node, method_chain, method_call, *removal_ranges) do |corrector|
            corrector.insert_before(method_call.loc.dot, '&') unless method_call.safe_navigation?
          end
        end

        def evaluate_style_and(cop, node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = nil
          @style_method_chain = node
          style_collect_and_clauses(cop, node).each do |(lhs, lhs_operator_range), (rhs, _rhs_operator_range)|
            lhs_not_nil_check = cop.send(:not_nil_check?, lhs)
            lhs_receiver = lhs_not_nil_check || lhs
            rhs_receiver = style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(cop.send(:strip_begin, rhs), lhs_receiver)
            @style_variable = lhs_receiver
            @style_receiver = rhs_receiver
            @style_method_chain = rhs

            next if !cop.send(:cop_config)['ConvertCodeThatCanStartToReturnNil'] && lhs_not_nil_check
            next unless style_offending_node?(cop, node, lhs_receiver, rhs, rhs_receiver)

            lhs_method_chain = style_find_method_chain(lhs_receiver)
            next unless lhs_method_chain == lhs_receiver || lhs_not_nil_check

            style_report_offense(
              cop,
              node,
              rhs, rhs_receiver,
              cop.send(:range_with_surrounding_space, range: lhs.source_range, side: :right),
              cop.send(:range_with_surrounding_space, range: lhs_operator_range, side: :right),
              offense_range: cop.send(:range_between, lhs.source_range.begin_pos, rhs.source_range.end_pos)
            )
          end
        end

        def evaluate_chain_length(cop, node)
          @chain_snapshot = node
          @chain_nodes = []
          @chain_tail = node
          chains = chain_length_ancestors(node)
          @chain_nodes = chains
          @chain_tail = chains.last
          return if chains.size < chain_length_max(cop)

          cop.add_offense(chains.last, message: format(cop.class::MSG, max: chain_length_max(cop)))
        end

        def evaluate_empty_in_conditional(cop, node)
          @paren_context = node
          @paren_parent_type = :if
          @paren_operator = :empty?
          return unless cop.send(:safe_navigation_empty_in_conditional?, node)

          condition = node.condition
          @paren_context = condition
          @paren_operator = condition.method_name
          cop.add_offense(condition) do |corrector|
            receiver = condition.receiver.source
            corrector.replace(condition, "#{receiver} && #{receiver}.#{condition.method_name}")
          end
        end

        private

        def require_safe_navigation?(node)
          parent = node.parent
          return true unless parent&.and_type?

          parent.rhs != node || parent.lhs.receiver != parent.rhs.receiver
        end

        def add_safe_navigation_operator(offense_range:, send_node:)
          source =
            if brackets?(send_node)
              format(
                '%<method_name>s(%<arguments>s)%<method_chain>s',
                arguments: send_node.arguments.map(&:source).join(', '),
                method_name: send_node.method_name,
                method_chain: send_node.source_range.end.join(send_node.source_range.end).source
              )
            else
              offense_range.source
            end
          source.prepend('.') unless source.start_with?('.')
          source.prepend('&')
        end

        def autocorrect(corrector, offense_range:, send_node:)
          corrector.replace(
            offense_range,
            add_safe_navigation_operator(offense_range: offense_range, send_node: send_node)
          )

          corrector.wrap(send_node, '(', ')') if require_parentheses?(send_node)
        end

        def brackets?(send_node)
          send_node.method?(:[]) || send_node.method?(:[]=)
        end

        def assume_receiver_instance_exists?(receiver)
          return true if receiver.const_type? && !receiver.short_name.match?(SNAKE_CASE)

          receiver.self_type? || (receiver.literal? && !receiver.nil_type?)
        end

        def redundant_check?(node)
          parent = node.parent
          return false unless parent

          redundant_condition?(parent, node) ||
            parent.operator_keyword? ||
            (parent.send_type? && parent.negation_method?)
        end

        def redundant_condition?(parent, node)
          (parent.conditional? || parent.post_condition_loop?) && parent.condition == node
        end

        def consistency_collect_operands(node, operand_nodes)
          consistency_operand_nodes(node.lhs, operand_nodes)
          consistency_operand_nodes(node.rhs, operand_nodes)
          @consistency_operands = operand_nodes
          operand_nodes
        end

        def consistency_receiver_name_as_key(method, fully_receivers)
          @consistency_dot_op = fully_receivers
          if method.parent.call_type?
            receiver(method.parent, fully_receivers)
          else
            fully_receivers << method.receiver&.source.to_s
          end
        end

        def consistency_find_consistent_parts(cop, grouped_operands)
          @consistency_groups = grouped_operands
          csend_in_and, csend_in_or, send_in_and, send_in_or = consistency_most_left_indices(cop, grouped_operands)

          return if csend_in_and && csend_in_or && csend_in_and < csend_in_or

          if csend_in_and
            @consistency_dot_op = '.'
            ['.', (send_in_and ? [send_in_and, csend_in_and].min : csend_in_and) + 1]
          elsif send_in_or && csend_in_or
            if send_in_or < csend_in_or
              @consistency_dot_op = '.'
              ['.', send_in_or + 1]
            else
              @consistency_dot_op = '&.'
              ['&.', csend_in_or + 1]
            end
          elsif send_in_and && csend_in_or && send_in_and < csend_in_or
            @consistency_dot_op = '.'
            ['.', csend_in_or]
          end
        end

        def consistency_already_appropriate_call?(operand, dot_op)
          @consistency_dot_op = dot_op
          return true if operand.safe_navigation? && dot_op == '&.'

          (operand.dot? || operand.operator_method?) && dot_op == '.'
        end

        def consistency_register_offense(cop, operand, dot_operator)
          @consistency_dot_op = dot_operator
          offense_range = operand.operator_method? ? operand : operand.loc.dot
          message = dot_operator == '.' ? cop.class::USE_DOT_MSG : cop.class::USE_SAFE_NAVIGATION_MSG

          cop.add_offense(offense_range, message: message) do |corrector|
            next if operand.operator_method?

            corrector.replace(operand.loc.dot, dot_operator)
          end
        end

        def consistency_operand_nodes(operand, operand_nodes)
          @consistency_operands = operand_nodes
          if operand.operator_keyword?
            consistency_collect_operands(operand, operand_nodes)
          elsif operand.call_type?
            operand_nodes << operand
          end
        end

        def consistency_most_left_indices(cop, grouped_operands)
          @consistency_groups = grouped_operands
          indices = { csend_in_and: nil, csend_in_or: nil, send_in_and: nil, send_in_or: nil }

          grouped_operands.each_with_index do |operand, index|
            indices[:csend_in_and] ||= index if consistency_operand_in_and?(operand) && operand.csend_type?
            indices[:csend_in_or] ||= index if consistency_operand_in_or?(operand) && operand.csend_type?
            indices[:send_in_and] ||= index if consistency_operand_in_and?(operand) && !consistency_nilable?(cop, operand)
            indices[:send_in_or] ||= index if consistency_operand_in_or?(operand) && !consistency_nilable?(cop, operand)
          end

          indices.values
        end

        def consistency_operand_in_and?(node)
          @consistency_operands = Array(@consistency_operands)
          return true if node.parent.and_type?

          parent = node.parent.parent while node.parent.begin_type?

          parent&.and_type?
        end

        def consistency_operand_in_or?(node)
          @consistency_operands = Array(@consistency_operands)
          return true if node.parent.or_type?

          parent = node.parent.parent while node.parent.begin_type?

          parent&.or_type?
        end

        def consistency_nilable?(cop, node)
          @consistency_dot_op = node
          node.csend_type? || cop.send(:nil_methods).include?(node.method_name)
        end

        def chain_length_ancestors(node)
          @chain_snapshot = node
          @chain_nodes = []
          @chain_tail = node
          node.each_ancestor.with_object([]) do |parent, chains|
            break chains unless parent.csend_type?

            chains << parent
            @chain_nodes = chains
            @chain_tail = parent
          end
        end

        def chain_length_max(cop)
          @chain_snapshot = @chain_snapshot || cop
          cop.send(:cop_config)['Max'] || 2
        end

        def style_report_offense(cop, node, rhs, rhs_receiver, *removal_ranges, offense_range: node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = rhs_receiver
          @style_method_chain = rhs
          cop.add_offense(offense_range) do |corrector|
            next if cop.send(:and_with_rhs_or?, node)

            removal_ranges.each { |range| corrector.remove(range) }
            yield corrector if block_given?

            style_handle_comments(cop, corrector, node, rhs)

            style_add_safe_nav_to_all_methods_in_chain(corrector, rhs_receiver, rhs)
          end
        end

        def style_find_method_chain(node)
          @style_method_chain = node
          @style_receiver = node
          @style_variable = node
          return node unless node&.parent&.call_type?

          style_find_method_chain(node.parent)
        end

        def style_collect_and_clauses(cop, node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = node
          @style_method_chain = node
          node.each_descendant(:and)
              .inject(style_and_parts(cop, node)) { |nodes, and_node| style_concat_nodes(cop, nodes, and_node) }
              .sort_by { |a| a.is_a?(RuboCop::AST::Node) ? a.source_range.begin_pos : a.begin_pos }
              .each_slice(2)
              .each_cons(2)
        end

        def style_concat_nodes(cop, nodes, and_node)
          @style_method_chain = and_node
          @style_variable = and_node
          @style_receiver = and_node
          return nodes if and_node.each_ancestor(:block).any?

          nodes.concat(style_and_parts(cop, and_node))
        end

        def style_and_parts(cop, node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = node
          @style_method_chain = node
          parts = [node.loc.operator]
          parts << node.rhs unless cop.send(:and_inside_begin?, node.rhs)
          parts << node.lhs unless node.lhs.and_type? || cop.send(:and_inside_begin?, node.lhs)
          parts
        end

        def style_offending_node?(cop, node, lhs_receiver, rhs, rhs_receiver)
          @style_variable = lhs_receiver
          @style_receiver = rhs_receiver
          @style_method_chain = rhs
          return false if lhs_receiver != rhs_receiver || rhs_receiver.nil?
          return false if style_use_var_only_in_unless_modifier?(node, lhs_receiver)
          return false if style_chain_length(rhs, rhs_receiver) > style_max_chain_length(cop)
          return false if style_unsafe_method_used?(cop, rhs, rhs_receiver.parent)
          return false if rhs.send_type? && rhs.method?(:empty?)

          true
        end

        def style_use_var_only_in_unless_modifier?(node, variable)
          @style_variable = variable
          @style_receiver = variable
          @style_method_chain = node
          node.if_type? && node.unless? && !style_method_called?(variable)
        end

        def style_extract_if_body(node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = node
          @style_method_chain = node
          if node.ternary?
            node.branches.find { |branch| !branch.nil_type? }
          else
            node.node_parts[1]
          end
        end

        def style_handle_comments(cop, corrector, node, method_call)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = method_call
          @style_method_chain = method_call
          comments = style_comments(cop, node)
          return if comments.empty?

          corrector.insert_before(method_call, "#{comments.map(&:text).join("\n")}\n")
        end

        def style_comments(cop, node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = node
          @style_method_chain = node
          style_relevant_comment_ranges(node).each.with_object([]) do |range, comments|
            comments.concat(cop.processed_source.each_comment_in_lines(range).to_a)
          end
        end

        def style_relevant_comment_ranges(node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = node
          @style_method_chain = node
          begin_pos = node.loc.first_line
          end_pos = node.loc.last_line

          node.child_nodes.each.with_object([]) do |child, ranges|
            ranges << (begin_pos...child.loc.first_line)
            begin_pos = child.loc.last_line
          end << (begin_pos...end_pos)
        end

        def style_allowed_if_condition?(node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = node
          @style_method_chain = node
          node.else? || node.elsif?
        end

        def style_extract_parts_from_if(cop, node)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = node
          @style_method_chain = node
          variable, receiver =
            if node.ternary?
              cop.send(:ternary_safe_navigation_candidate, node)
            else
              cop.send(:modifier_if_safe_navigation_candidate, node)
            end

          checked_variable, matching_receiver, method = style_extract_common_parts(receiver, variable)

          matching_receiver = nil if receiver && cop.class::LOGIC_JUMP_KEYWORDS.include?(receiver.type)

          [checked_variable, matching_receiver, receiver, method]
        end

        def style_extract_common_parts(method_chain, checked_variable)
          @style_variable = checked_variable
          @style_receiver = method_chain
          @style_method_chain = method_chain
          matching_receiver = style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(method_chain, checked_variable)

          method = matching_receiver.parent if matching_receiver

          [checked_variable, matching_receiver, method]
        end

        def style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(method_chain, checked_variable)
          @style_variable = checked_variable
          @style_receiver = method_chain
          @style_method_chain = method_chain
          return nil unless method_chain.respond_to?(:receiver)

          receiver_node = method_chain.receiver

          return receiver_node if receiver_node == checked_variable

          style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(receiver_node, checked_variable)
        end

        def style_chain_length(method_chain, method)
          @style_variable = method
          @style_receiver = method
          @style_method_chain = method_chain
          method.each_ancestor(:send, :csend).inject(0) do |total, ancestor|
            break total + 1 if ancestor == method_chain

            total + 1
          end
        end

        def style_unsafe_method_used?(cop, method_chain, method)
          @style_variable = method
          @style_receiver = method
          @style_method_chain = method_chain
          return true if style_unsafe_method?(method)

          method.each_ancestor(:send).any? do |ancestor|
            break true unless cop.config.cop_enabled?('Lint/SafeNavigationChain')

            break true if style_unsafe_method?(ancestor)
            break true if cop.send(:nil_methods).include?(ancestor.method_name)
            break false if ancestor == method_chain
          end
        end

        def style_unsafe_method?(send_node)
          @style_variable = send_node
          @style_receiver = send_node
          @style_method_chain = send_node
          style_negated?(send_node) ||
            send_node.assignment? ||
            (!send_node.dot? && !send_node.safe_navigation?)
        end

        def style_negated?(send_node)
          @style_variable = send_node
          @style_receiver = send_node
          @style_method_chain = send_node
          if style_method_called?(send_node)
            style_negated?(send_node.parent)
          else
            send_node.send_type? && send_node.method?(:!)
          end
        end

        def style_method_called?(send_node)
          @style_variable = send_node
          @style_receiver = send_node
          @style_method_chain = send_node
          send_node&.parent&.send_type?
        end

        def style_begin_range(cop, node, method_call)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = method_call
          @style_method_chain = method_call
          cop.send(:range_between, node.source_range.begin_pos, method_call.source_range.begin_pos)
        end

        def style_end_range(cop, node, method_call)
          @style_variable = node
          @style_receiver = method_call
          @style_method_chain = method_call
          cop.send(:range_between, method_call.source_range.end_pos, node.source_range.end_pos)
        end

        def style_add_safe_nav_to_all_methods_in_chain(corrector, start_method, method_chain)
          @style_variable = start_method
          @style_receiver = start_method
          @style_method_chain = method_chain
          start_method.each_ancestor do |ancestor|
            break unless %i[send block].include?(ancestor.type)
            next unless ancestor.send_type?
            next if ancestor.safe_navigation?

            corrector.insert_before(ancestor.loc.dot, '&')

            break if ancestor == method_chain
          end
        end

        def style_max_chain_length(cop)
          @style_variable = cop
          @style_receiver = cop
          @style_method_chain = cop
          cop.send(:cop_config).fetch('MaxChainLength', 2)
        end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Lint
      # The safe navigation operator returns nil if the receiver is
      # nil. If you chain an ordinary method call after a safe
      # navigation operator, it raises NoMethodError. We should use a
      # safe navigation operator after a safe navigation operator.
      # This cop checks for the problem outlined above.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop's autocorrection is unsafe because it changes the behavior of
      #   the code: `x&.foo.bar` raises `NoMethodError` when `x` or `x&.foo` is `nil`,
      #   whereas the corrected `x&.foo&.bar` returns `nil` instead. The autocorrection
      #   also assumes that extending safe navigation through the chain is intended,
      #   while removing the first `&.` may be what was intended instead.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   x&.foo.bar
      #   x&.foo + bar
      #   x&.foo[bar]
      #
      #   # good
      #   x&.foo&.bar
      #   x&.foo || bar
      class SafeNavigationChain < Base
        include NilMethods
        extend AutoCorrector
        extend TargetRubyVersion

        minimum_target_ruby_version 2.3

        MSG = 'Do not chain ordinary method call after safe navigation operator.'
        PLUS_MINUS_METHODS = %i[+@ -@].freeze

        # @!method bad_method?(node)
        def_node_matcher :bad_method?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (send $(csend ...) $_ ...)
            (send $(any_block (csend ...) ...) $_ ...)
            (send $(begin (csend ...)) $_ ...)
          }
        PATTERN

        # rubocop:disable-next Metrics/AbcSize
        def on_send(node)
          return unless require_safe_navigation?(node)

          bad_method?(node) do |safe_nav, method|
            return if nil_methods.include?(method) || PLUS_MINUS_METHODS.include?(node.method_name)
            return if ternary_safe_navigation?(node, safe_nav)

            begin_range = node.loc.dot || safe_nav.source_range.end
            location = begin_range.join(node.source_range.end)

            add_offense(location) do |corrector|
              next if ternary_else_branch?(node, safe_nav)

              autocorrect(corrector, offense_range: location, send_node: node)
            end
          end
        end

        private

        def require_safe_navigation?(node)
          parent = node.parent
          return true unless parent&.and_type?

          parent.rhs != node || parent.lhs.receiver != parent.rhs.receiver
        end

        def ternary_safe_navigation?(node, safe_nav)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.if_type? && node.equal?(parent.if_branch) && parent.condition == safe_nav
        end

        def ternary_else_branch?(node, safe_nav)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.if_type? && node.equal?(parent.else_branch) && parent.condition == safe_nav
        end

        # @param [Parser::Source::Range] offense_range
        # @param [RuboCop::AST::SendNode] send_node
        # @return [String]
        def add_safe_navigation_operator(offense_range:, send_node:)
          source =
            if brackets?(send_node)
              format(
                '%<method_name>s(%<arguments>s)%<method_chain>s',
                arguments: send_node.arguments.map(&:source).join(', '),
                method_name: send_node.method_name,
                method_chain: send_node.source_range.end.join(send_node.source_range.end).source
              )
            else
              offense_range.source
            end
          source.prepend('.') unless source.start_with?('.')
          source.prepend('&')
        end

        # @param [RuboCop::Cop::Corrector] corrector
        # @param [Parser::Source::Range] offense_range
        # @param [RuboCop::AST::SendNode] send_node
        def autocorrect(corrector, offense_range:, send_node:)
          corrector.replace(
            offense_range,
            add_safe_navigation_operator(offense_range: offense_range, send_node: send_node)
          )

          corrector.wrap(send_node, '(', ')') if require_parentheses?(send_node)
        end

        def brackets?(send_node)
          send_node.method?(:[]) || send_node.method?(:[]=)
        end

        def require_parentheses?(send_node)
          return true if operator_inside_collection_literal?(send_node)
          return false unless send_node.comparison_method?
          return false unless (node = send_node.parent)

          (node.respond_to?(:logical_operator?) && node.logical_operator?) ||
            (node.respond_to?(:comparison_method?) && node.comparison_method?)
        end

        def operator_inside_collection_literal?(send_node)
          # If an operator call (without a dot) is inside an array or a hash, it needs
          # to be parenthesized when converted to safe navigation.
          send_node.parent&.type?(:array, :pair) && !send_node.loc.dot
        end
      end
    end
